_comment: Travelpayouts brand boxes. `brand` must be a key of TP_BRANDS in links.ts and a program this site's project is subscribed to (check with `node scripts/monetize-links.mjs`).

car.title: Rent a car
car.text: Compare cars from local Icelandic rental companies, including 4x4s for the highlands and winter roads.

esim.title: Stay online
esim.text: Get a Saily eSIM before you fly: mobile data from the moment you land, no SIM swap or roaming bill.

insurance.title: Travel insurance
insurance.text: Cover for cancellations, medical costs and gear, for trips with glaciers, volcanoes and winter roads.

transfer.title: Airport transfer
transfer.text: A driver waiting at Keflavík arrivals, at a fixed price, to take you straight to your hotel.
